title: Elotuzumab Safety Surveillance In Japanese Patients With Relapse Or Refractory Multiple Myeloma
brief_summary: BMS will conduct a regulatory postmarketing surveillance (PMS) to evaluate the safety of elotuzumab in clinical practice in Japan.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who are beginning to receive elotuzumab at the selected sites will be included in this surveillance study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not Applicable
study_population: Patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who are beginning to receive elotuzumab at healthcare facilities in Japan.
